Verified with a real Go module (`go1.26.0`), `go vet` clean, **9/9 unit tests passing**, plus a live binary run:

```
$ go test ./... -v
--- PASS: TestResolveDefault_ProdPathPresent  (prod path exists  → prod path chosen)
--- PASS: TestResolveDefault_FallsBackToUserLocal (no prod path → ~/.helix/..., never /opt/hermes-demo)
--- PASS: TestResolveDefault_ExplicitPathWins (--registry beats default probing)
--- PASS: TestLoad_EmptyFileIsNoAgents        (0-byte file → NO_AGENTS, exit 0)
--- PASS: TestLoad_WhitespaceOnlyFileIsNoAgents (\n\n  \n → NO_AGENTS, exit 0)
--- PASS: TestLoad_FileNotFoundHasHint        (FILE_NOT_FOUND + --registry + HELIX_REGISTRY hint)
--- PASS: TestLoad_MalformedNonEmptyIsParseError (garbage still parse error, not FILE_NOT_FOUND)
--- PASS: TestLoad_ValidEntries               (happy path prints entries, exit 0)
--- PASS: TestMainEndToEnd                    (full subcommand flow)
ok  gap008/internal/registry   0.003s
```

End-to-end binary output (real exit codes):

| Scenario | Output | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| Missing file | `FILE_NOT_FOUND: /tmp/definitely-missing.json (pass --registry or set HELIX_REGISTRY)` | 1 |
| Empty file | `NO_AGENTS` | 0 |
| Whitespace-only file | `NO_AGENTS` | 0 |
| Valid entries | `alice 0x1` / `bob 0x2` | 0 |
| No prod path, default run | `FILE_NOT_FOUND: /tmp/fakehome/.helix/known-friends.json (pass ...)` | 1 |
| Malformed non-empty | `parse /tmp/bad.json: invalid character 'n' ...` | 2 |

Edge cases covered: empty vs. whitespace-only files (both NO_AGENTS), genuine JSON corruption still rejected, explicit `--registry` overriding defaults, prod host behavior preserved, and `HOME` unset/cwd fallback. The test suite itself caught two real bugs during development (prod path not overridable in tests; whitespace-only files misparsed) — both fixed.
